scope: Bounded review of two distinctive broad-leaf regions and six candidate same-leaf windows in P5; not an exhaustive impossibility claim.
source_depth_method: Saved RGB multi-view recovered depth, undistorted RGB raster; not assumed L515/HSI ray geometry
coordinate_scale: Original reconstructed reference frame; physical scale remains conditional on unknown recording units. Consistent arbitrary units would be sufficient for pixel-validation if correspondences existed.
